introCutscene.text: A video of Mayor Chen has gone viral. In it, she appears to resign effective immediately.
The opposition is calling for an emergency election. Your job: determine if this video is authentic.
Examine the video frame by frame. Check the audio spectrogram. Look for inconsistencies.

conclusionText: The video was indeed AI-generated. A subtle audio artifact in the 2-4kHz range and inconsistent lip-sync timing revealed the manipulation. Always verify through multiple channels.
